family: R5-D2 data: macro-daily regime-conditional policy on frozen majority_1x (local only)
hypothesis: BTC swing PnL của tín hiệu majority_1x phụ thuộc regime vĩ mô: risk-on (SPY>MA50) mang phần lớn lợi nhuận; risk-off và các lúc USD tăng nóng (DXY z>1.5) kéo DD. Chưa ai thử dữ liệu macro mới này (ledger round5 D2).
macro_source: Yahoo Finance Chart API v8 (free, no key). Stooq free CSV bi chan tren host nay (HTTP 404 / JS-challenge) nen dung Yahoo, ghi ro nguon.

regime.causality: Decision ngay T chi dung macro dong cua ngay T-1 tro ve truoc (strictly: macro date < UTC date cua signal_time). Regime features past-only, khong refit.
regime.risk_on: SPY close(T-1) > MA50 cua SPY (mean 50 daily close ket thuc T-1). risk_off = nguoc lai.
regime.dxy_z60: (DXY close(T-1) - mean60) / std60 (ddof=1), mean/std tren 60 daily close ket thuc T-1. strong_dxy = z > 1.5.
regime.vix_proxy_amp20: (max high 20d - min low 20d) / close(T-1) cua SPY, 20 daily bar ket thuc T-1. CHI MO TA, khong lam filter trong matrix nay.
regime.nan_policy: Neu thieu macro (NaN): risk_on/risk_off = drop khoi ca 2 nhanh; strong_dxy = giu lai (khong cam). Thuc te 0 NaN tren 94 tin hieu (macro tu 2022-01).
regime.gld_note: GLD/GC crawl de coverage + thong ke mo ta; matrix nay chi filter theo SPY/DXY theo nhiem vu.

filters.control: giu tat ca 94 tin hieu frozen
filters.risk_on_only: chi giu tin hieu co risk_on == True
filters.risk_off_only: chi giu tin hieu co risk_on == False

method: Subset truc tiep 94 tin hieu majority_1x frozen (da qua frequency loop monthly-cap-4 + cooldown-5d o v15); KHONG chay lai frequency loop. Control rerun phai khop artifact goc. dd_guard ap dung tren subset cua tung nhanh.
control: control_1x normal phai khop majority_1x goc (+165.17829563633% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.086073993367803% max_drawdown, 63 trades) hoac STOP
dd_guard_reference: control_1x (majority_1x rerun) sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after, trade-candle-close sampled), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed; moi nhanh ap dung guard tai signal_time cua subset RIENG minh. Cong bo cong thuc, giong v15/v22.
execution_frozen: entry_expiry_bars=12 (dataset config), max_holding_bars=2016 (7d*288), tp1_fraction=0.5 (default), intrabar_policy=stop_first; giong he v15 de control khop. Chi subset tin hieu thay doi theo nhanh.
